title: PLAYER 2 HIT STOP BY THE HOST RULE
why: Hit stop (v26.55: a heavy round, 40 damage or more by the gun, holds the body for 0.06 s) was decided on the host for player 2's rounds by the number his window sent, which already has the weak point, armour and back shot multipliers in it, while the host's own rounds use the raw gun damage. Proven in the fixture: player 2's Auto Rifle round into a Bulwark spine (59.8) held the body every time, the host's never; his Magnum into a Bulwark front (7.44) never held it, the host's does; his frag, melee and air strike words (80 and up) held bodies, the host's own never do. Now player 2's gun round carries a heavy mark worked out from the raw gun damage exactly as the host round does, and the host holds the body only on that mark.
now: Heavy rounds from player 2 hold enemies for the same beat and on the same guns as player 1's, and his grenades and melee no longer hold them.
